title: Smoke barrier construction.
officialText:
Smoke barriers shall comply with Section 710, and shall be constructed and sealed to limit
leakage areas exclusive of protected openings. The maximum allowable leakage area shall be the aggregate area calculated using
the following leakage area ratios:
1. Walls: A/A = 0.00100
w
2. Exit enclosures: A/A = 0.00035
w
3. All other shafts: A/A = 0.00150
w
4. Floors and roofs: A/A = 0.00050
F
where:
A = Total leakage area, square feet (m2).
A = Unit floor or roof area of barrier, square feet (m2).
F
A = Unit wall area of barrier, square feet (m2).
w
The leakage area ratios shown do not include openings due to doors, operable windows or similar gaps. These shall be
included in calculating the total leakage area.
